which_lang: Which language should we explain in?
lang_note: Lessons and questions stay in English, like the exam. Explanations and key words can be in your language.
free_note: Chapter 1 is free. No account needed.
class_code_prompt: Type the code your teacher gave you
signin_soon: Sign-in arrives with the pilot. Your progress is saved on this phone for now.
change_later: You can change this any time.
review_empty: Nothing to review yet. Finish a lesson first.
guess_note: Nothing is marked here. It is just your first idea.
fits_why: {s} goes into {a} and into {b} a whole number of times.
gap_why: {s} does not go into {n} a whole number of times.
biggest_square: So the biggest square for the board is {a}.
not_quite_guess: Your guess was {g}. The answer is {a}.
spelling_note: Spelling and number format do not matter. Meaning does.
right_idea: Right idea. The usual spelling is "{a}".
wrong_pick: Look at {n} again. Does it divide {a} and also {b}?
missing_pick: Everything you picked is right, but something is missing. Test each number in turn.
all_done: Every question is done. Well worked.
replay_note: {n} to replay. Only the ones you missed come back.
comes_back: This idea comes back tomorrow, then in 3 days, then next week.
test_note: No clues in the test. Answer, then see the result.
report_unclear: I did not understand the explanation
sent: Thank you. A teacher reads every report.
install: Add Meseret to your home screen
install_how: In your browser menu, choose "Add to Home screen".
offline: You are offline. Chapters you opened before still work.
review_done: Review done. Next ideas come back in a few days.
no_lessons_yet: Interactive lessons for this chapter are coming. Open the chapter to read and practise.
exams_intro: Practise the way you will be tested: the book's exercises and short unit tests, without clues.
data_note: Works on any phone. A lesson uses less data than one photo.
